evals.name: audit-defaults-to-the-diff
evals.setup: A writable checkout of a skills repo with the `<group>/skills/<name>/` layout and its eval scripts working. Two skills, `craft:cm` and `go:style`, are clean at HEAD; the working tree changes only `craft/skills/cm/SKILL.md`, adding a rule that contradicts one of its `contract.json` phrases and a 40-line section past the token aim.
evals.requires: A writable skills-repo checkout with the `<group>/skills/<name>/` layout, its eval tools runnable, and the `claude` CLI signed in: the probe, hunt, and trigger tiers call models, which a sandboxed agent case cannot. A stand-in that reads the tools' output from a fixture does not establish that the skill runs them, in order, against the right target.

evals.name: fix-commits-each-improvement
